# Veda

> Veda is an open-source, Rust-native multimodal vector database and RAG platform.
> It stores, indexes, and searches embeddings from any modality — text, images,
> audio, video, and documents — in one unified vector space, so you can index with
> text and query with any modality (cross-modal retrieval) without re-indexing.
> It ships hybrid search (dense + sparse/SPLADE + BM25 with RRF/weighted fusion),
> reranking, ColPali, 7+ ANN index types (HNSW, DiskANN, IVF-PQ, Flat, RaBitQ, SQ8),
> a document pipeline (OCR → chunk → embed → insert), an agent framework with a
> built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and a vector-native observability /
> AIOps / LLM-observability layer. Includes Niriksha, a visual exploration dashboard.

## Getting started
- [Introduction](https://veda.example/docs/introduction): what Veda is and who it's for
- [Quick start](https://veda.example/docs/quickstart): run Veda and do your first search in minutes
- [Installation & config](https://veda.example/docs/installation): build/run, environment, Docker profiles

## Core concepts
- [Collections & fields](https://veda.example/docs/collections): schema, vector/scalar/sparse fields
- [Indexes](https://veda.example/docs/indexes): HNSW, DiskANN, IVF-PQ, Flat, RaBitQ, SQ8 — when to use which
- [Search & fusion](https://veda.example/docs/search): dense, sparse, BM25, hybrid (RRF/weighted), rerank
- [Multimodal & cross-modal](https://veda.example/docs/multimodal): one embedding space for text·image·audio·video
- [Document pipeline](https://veda.example/docs/document-pipeline): OCR → chunk → embed → insert
- [Agents & MCP](https://veda.example/docs/agents-mcp): agent framework + MCP server tool catalog
- [Web Connectors](https://veda.example/docs/web-connectors): web ingestion + agentic web search

## Reference
- [REST API](https://veda.example/docs/rest-api): the HTTP API surface
- [Python SDK](https://veda.example/docs/python-sdk): the veda-client package
- [Observability](https://veda.example/docs/observability): metrics, tracing, explain timings
- [APM & Performance](https://veda.example/docs/apm-observability): distributed tracing, profiling, index advisor
- [LLM Observability](https://veda.example/docs/llm-observability): semantic cache, guardrails, trace store
- [AIOps](https://veda.example/docs/aiops): change-point detection, spike attribution, incident drafts
- [Ops Advisor](https://veda.example/docs/ops-advisor): rule catalog, RCA, recommendations, alerting
- [Log Insights](https://veda.example/docs/log-insights): semantic log categorization + log-content alerting
- [Node Resource Signals](https://veda.example/docs/resource-signals): disk/CPU/load/fd/mem monitoring
- [Service Reliability](https://veda.example/docs/service-reliability): SLOs, error budgets, synthetics, AI triage
- [RAG & AIOps Intelligence](https://veda.example/docs/rag-aiops): faithfulness, citations, eval, forecasting
